title: The Telangana Water Resources Regulatory Commission Act, 2009.
full_text: The Telangana Water Resources Regulatory Commission Act, 2009. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200915 Act Number: 15 Enactment Date: 2009-09-08 Act Year: 2009 Short Title: The Telangana Water Resources Regulatory Commission Act, 2009. Long Title: An Act to provide for the establishment of the Telangana Water Resources Regulatory Commission for regulation of water resources within the State of Telangana, facilitate effective utilization of water resources within the State to ensure its sustainable and Scientific Management for Drinking, Agriculture, Industrial and other purposes and matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
